From: hr@northbank-retail.example
To: intake@synthetic-law.example
Date: July 1, 2026
Subject: ADA/FMLA demand and missing leave file

Northbank Retail Group received a demand from Priya Shah alleging failure to accommodate, FMLA interference, and retaliation after a leave request. The HR note says the employee handbook, leave request packet, and interactive-process notes were attached, but intake has only this correspondence dump. Northbank asks whether the store manager, regional HR lead, and benefits administrator need to be treated as witnesses or individual role candidates.

-----Original Message-----
From: benefits@northbank-retail.example
To: hr@northbank-retail.example
Subject: RE: Shah leave file

The leave file may be incomplete. The handbook section, accommodation emails, and third-party leave administrator notes should be collected before a budget range is narrowed.

Regards,
Synthetic HR
